text_block_list.text: Бива Хаяхидэ's big day has arrived!

This debut race is full of promising
prospects who
just signed on with new
trainers.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
At long last, I get to see the results of
my
training. It's time to focus and do
this!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I promise I won't let you down.
Let's take
home a win.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
